name: Alpino Nochhöher
personality: Regards every summit as a badly placed supply depot.
visual_intent: tall hunched comma blob, soft grey-green alpine hat with ONE long dark feather and short rope loop, compact ice axe; sorrowfully arched brows and deep toothless frown
biography: Regards every summit as a badly placed supply depot. He climbs HyperNorm stairwells with a rope reserved for approved routes. A dissonant card points toward somebody stranded one floor lower. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Gipfel ist erreicht. Der Nachschub nicht.

name: Bersagliere Eilfertig
personality: Runs ahead because waiting would make the order seem less certain.
visual_intent: lean asymmetrical forward-tilted splat, compact dark feather-plumed helmet, wood-stock carbine upright beside body; ecstatic one-eye-squint open laugh, two upper teeth
biography: Runs ahead because waiting would make the order seem less certain. His feathered helmet reaches every HyperNorm inspection before his doubts do. A dissonant card asks why he is hurrying. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Eile ist angeordnet. Der Anlass folgt.

name: Tenente Domani
personality: Sees both sides of a situation and requisitions a third.
visual_intent: round top-heavy blob, plain grey-green peaked cap and small map case, brass binoculars held below mouth; wide uncertain eyes, little crooked toothless smile
biography: Sees both sides of a situation and requisitions a third. His binoculars reveal two HyperNorm routes both marked as the only correct one. He keeps the map case closed during briefings. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Aussicht wurde erweitert. Die Entscheidung vertagt.

name: Meccanica Valvola
personality: Treats impossible machinery as a personal invitation.
visual_intent: broad low splat in soft work cap, goggles on cap, tiny canvas bib patch; chunky spanner and single small valve; lashes, triumphant asymmetric grin with one upper tooth
biography: Treats impossible machinery as a personal invitation. Her valve releases the pressure that HyperNorm policy calls essential. A dissonant card suggests trying the same repair on a meeting. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Ventil funktioniert. Der Druck bleibt amtlich.

name: Radiofonista Quasichiaro
personality: Keeps the channel clear of everything except inconvenient questions.
visual_intent: thin curved pear blob, khaki sidecap and short headset, one compact field radio with handset; lashes and heavy side-eye, tightly compressed toothless wavy lips
biography: Keeps the channel clear of everything except inconvenient questions. Her receiver carries HyperNorm certainty on one channel and questions on the other. She keeps both tuned despite the interference. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Kanal ist frei von vorzeitigen Gewissheiten.

name: Sanitario Semprepronto
personality: Has prepared for every emergency except the scheduled one.
visual_intent: round drooping ink splat, plain steel bowl helmet and medical pouch with simple ivory plus, rolled bandage balanced in goo hand; startled high brows and small open oval mouth with no teeth
biography: Has prepared for every emergency except the scheduled one. His bandage roll is divided into planned and unplanned injuries. HyperNorm residents keep needing the unplanned half first. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Für Unvorhergesehenes vorbereitet, ausgenommen heute.
